overview.title: Strategic financial leadership that builds business value.
overview.text: Every engagement is tailored to your business, your goals, and the level of support you need.

services.title: Profitability
services.summary: Grow profitable revenue, not just revenue.
services.text: Healthy businesses do not simply grow revenue, they grow profitable revenue. We find the opportunities to improve margins and manage operating costs.
services.lead: Healthy businesses do not simply grow revenue. They grow profitable revenue. We help identify opportunities to improve margins, manage operating costs as a percentage of revenue, and increase long-term profitability.

covers.title: Margin improvement
covers.text: Where the money is actually made across products, services and customers, and where it leaks away.

covers.title: Operating costs
covers.text: Costs read as a percentage of revenue, so they can be managed as the business grows rather than after the fact.

covers.title: KPI reporting
covers.text: Performance insight reported against the measures that move profit, not a stack of statements.

covers.title: Profitable growth
covers.text: Growth planned so that the extra revenue carries a margin worth having.

questions.q: Why is my business busy but not profitable?
questions.a: Revenue and profit are different things. We look at margins by line of business and at operating costs as a share of revenue to find where the profit is going.

services.title: Cash Flow
services.text: Strong cash flow creates flexibility. We improve working capital, strengthen banking relationships and evaluate financing so the business can support its own growth.
services.lead: Strong cash flow creates flexibility. We help improve working capital, strengthen banking relationships, evaluate financing strategies, and ensure the business has the resources to support future growth.

covers.title: Working capital
covers.text: Receivables, payables and inventory managed so cash is available when the business needs it.

covers.title: Banking relationships
covers.text: A stronger position with your bank, and the reporting a lender wants to see.

covers.title: Financing strategy
covers.text: Whether to borrow, how much, and what the repayment does to the months that follow.

covers.title: Resources for growth
covers.text: Making sure the cash is there before the business commits to what comes next.

questions.q: Are profits and cash flow the same thing?
questions.a: No. A profitable business can still run short of cash. Managing receivables and payables is often what keeps a business going.

services.title: Financial Models
services.summary: Target, actual and forecast in one view.
services.text: Target to actual to forecast models that show where the business is headed, not just where it has been. Better visibility leads to better decisions.
services.lead: We build financial operating models on a Target, Actual and Forecast basis, so you can see where the business is headed rather than only where it has been. Better visibility leads to better decisions.

covers.title: Target
covers.text: What the business is aiming at, written down in numbers rather than held in your head.

covers.title: Actual
covers.text: What really happened, read against the target while there is still time to act on it.

covers.title: Forecast
covers.text: Where the next months land on current trends, so a problem shows up before it arrives.

covers.title: Performance insight
covers.text: KPI reporting built on the model, so the same numbers run the business month after month.

services.title: Decision Support
services.summary: The financial impact before you commit.
services.text: Hiring, expanding, buying equipment, seeking financing or weighing a new opportunity. We help you understand the financial implications before you commit.
services.lead: Every important business decision has a financial impact. Whether you are hiring, expanding, purchasing equipment, seeking financing, or evaluating a new opportunity, we help you understand the financial implications before you commit.

covers.title: Hiring and expansion
covers.text: What the next hire or the next location does to profit and to cash, month by month.

covers.title: Equipment and capital
covers.text: Purchase, lease or wait, costed out against what the business can carry.

covers.title: Financing decisions
covers.text: What a facility really costs, and what the bank will want in return.

covers.title: New opportunities
covers.text: A new line, a new customer or a new market, modelled before the commitment is made.

services.title: Growth Planning
services.text: Growth, succession and exit all need a clear financial strategy. We help make sure today's decisions support tomorrow's goals.
services.lead: Growth, succession, and exit planning all require a clear financial strategy. We help ensure today's decisions support tomorrow's goals, whether you are scaling, evaluating a merger or acquisition, securing financing, or preparing for an eventual transition.

covers.title: Scaling the business
covers.text: Growth planned around what the finances can actually carry.

covers.title: Mergers and acquisitions
covers.text: The financial side of buying, selling or combining, read before the terms are agreed.

covers.title: Succession
covers.text: Handing the business on without the numbers becoming the obstacle.

covers.title: Exit preparation
covers.text: Getting the business into the shape a buyer wants, well ahead of the sale.

services.title: Business Value
services.text: Every financial decision should contribute to building a stronger, more profitable and more valuable business, wherever it is in its journey.
services.lead: Every financial decision should contribute to building a stronger, more profitable, and more valuable business, regardless of where the business is in its journey.

covers.title: Value drivers
covers.text: The handful of things that move what the business is worth, tracked rather than guessed at.

covers.title: A seat at your table

covers.title: Measurable value
covers.text: Work priced on the value we expect to create, so a Fractional CFO is an investment rather than another expense.

about.title: More than a CPA. A strategic financial partner.
text: HigherUp CFO Services was founded by Teresa Wagonseller, CPA. For more than 30 years she has worked with business owners and leadership teams, helping them make better financial decisions through experience gained in public accounting, tax, audit, corporate finance and entrepreneurship.

As a CPA, Teresa has a deep appreciation for accurate financial reporting. Tax returns, audits and financial statements are essential, and they tell us where a business has been. As a Strategic Fractional CFO, her focus is different: helping business owners use that financial information to make better decisions about where the business is headed.

The most successful business owners do not make important decisions alone. They surround themselves with trusted advisors who bring experience, ask the right questions and provide objective financial insight when it matters most. Our role is to earn a seat at your leadership table.

faqs.q: What is a Strategic Fractional CFO?
faqs.a: Executive-level financial leadership on a flexible, part-time basis. You get the experience of a CFO without the cost of hiring one full-time.

faqs.q: How is this different from my CPA or bookkeeper?
faqs.a: Tax returns, audits and financial statements tell us where the business has been. A Fractional CFO helps you use that information to decide where it is headed. We work alongside your existing CPA, bookkeeper, banker and attorney rather than replacing them.
Established small and mid-sized businesses whose financial decisions have become more complex as they have grown.

With a complimentary Financial Strategy Assessment. We discuss your business goals, current opportunities, financial priorities, and whether a Fractional CFO partnership is the right fit. There is no cost and no obligation.
There is no one-size-fits-all CFO solution. Every engagement is customized around your business and priced based on the value we expect to create.

faqs.q: Do we have to meet in person?
faqs.a: No. In-person meetings are available in Galveston and the surrounding area, and Zoom meetings are available for remote locations.

faqs.q: Should I be talking to a Fractional CFO?
faqs.a: If you are asking whether you are growing as profitably as you could, whether you can afford the next investment or hire, whether you are making the best use of your cash, or how today's decisions will affect the future, it may be time.
